newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ says CEO Don Mercer to retire.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ says CEO Don Mercer to retire.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Wednesday that chief executive officer Don Mercer planned to retire at the end of the year.

"Mr Mercer has advised his intention to retire at that time after providing leadership for what has been five years of enourmous progress and change for ANZ," ANZ chairman Charles Goode said in a statement accompanying the bank's half year results.
An ANZ spokeswoman told reporters that Mercer would retire at the end of 1997.
ANZ said a statement the bank's move to lobal lines of business through a project called ANZ Global which would include a new management structure to reflect and drive the transition.
